description:
Goal: pull the CompilerFragment arm of build_form (quoted_surface.rs:359-365) into a standalone build_definition_form(node, ctx) that turns a recognized def-head node (fn/fnp/defmacro/defmodule/defprotocol/defimpl) into its typed ScopeForm (Function/Module/Protocol/ProtocolImpl). build_form CompilerFragment continues to call it. No behavior change.

Why: the typed structural extraction must become a named define-tier operation, callable without a moded surface read. This isolates it without moving any caller yet.

Signal: build_definition_form exists and is the single source of def-head typed extraction; full lib green, zero warnings; behavior-identical. Blocks fz-s00.2.
title: Extract a mode-independent typed-definition builder
